$comment: The ship-release contract (docs/release-contract.md in https://github.com/ship-ecosystem/spec). Status: draft. Every field below is required because it is part of the first contract. A field added later must NOT be added to any `required` list: readers of older releases won't find it, and the contract says what its absence means. additionalProperties stays open everywhere, because readers ignore fields they don't know.
title: release.json
description: Describes one release folder written by a Ship producer (`ship release --tag <tag>`).

app.description: The Compose project name: the release Compose file's top-level `name:`. The same for every release of the project.

gitCommit.description: The commit released; null outside a git repository.

dirty.description: Whether the work tree had uncommitted changes; null outside a git repository.

compose.description: Relative path of the Compose file.

pulledImages.description: Images not built by the producer, pinned by digest.

http.description: Services that receive HTTP traffic. Empty when none.

role.description: Open list: site, websocket. Unknown: plain HTTP.

health.description: Path answering 2xx while the service works; null when unknown.

urlSetting.description: Name of the setting holding the public address browsers use for this entry; null when unknown. A name, never a value.

role.description: Open list: app, web, process, infrastructure. Unknown: process.

image.description: Equals an images[].ref or a pulledImages[].ref.

healthcheck.description: Whether the service has a Compose healthcheck.

volumes.description: Named volumes, as declared in Compose (no project prefix).

framework.description: Open list, e.g. laravel, symfony, tempest; null when unknown.

runtime.description: Open list, e.g. php-fpm, octane-swoole, octane-roadrunner, octane-frankenphp.

file.description: The settings file in the release, or null when it has none.

keys.description: Every key in the producer's production settings. Names only.

referenced.description: Every variable the Compose file interpolates.

required.description: Settings the release can't start without. A subset of keys.

deploy.description: One-off commands to run once per deploy; null when there are none.

console.description: How to run commands in the running app: the service, the user to run them as, its shell, and the framework's console commands.

service.description: The service to run commands in.

user.description: The user to run every command and shell as, so files they create stay writable by the app.

commands.description: The framework's console commands, by name: argv prefixes the arguments are appended to. Empty when unknown.

networks.description: External Docker networks that must exist.
